Dear Colleague,

I saw Devon Jones, a 46-year-old male, in consultation on July 26, 2025. The referral was to assess his atrial fibrillation/flutter, a condition he has been managing for many years. 

Mr. Jones was diagnosed with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation/flutter in 2003. His most recent echocardiogram, performed on the day of the consultation, showed normal cardiac structure and function. His CHA2DS2-VASc score is 4, indicating a moderate risk of stroke. Mr. Jones underwent catheter ablation for his arrhythmia 7.6 years ago and has been in controlled status for 22.7 years. At present, he not on any medications for this condition.

During the consultation, Mr. Jones's blood pressure was recorded at 141/80, and his weight was 223 pounds. His physical exam was otherwise unremarkable with no acute distress. Mr. Jones reports that he exercises regularly, running 3-4 times per week. 

Socially, Mr. Jones has a history of cigarette smoking, using approximately half a pack per day, but he quit in July 2022. He also consumes about 12 alcoholic drinks per week. His family history includes breast cancer in his mother, who was diagnosed at age 44 and passed away at 46, and stroke in his father who died at age 53.

Impression and recommendations as outlined above. Thank you for this referral.

Sincerely,

Dr. Scott Russell, Cardiologist
